definition.title: Simple path complements
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: After a motion verb, 上/下/进/出/过/回 can specify an upward, downward, inward, outward, crossing or returning path. Directional 过 is guò and describes passing a place; the unstressed experiential 过 is guo and describes prior experience. These path complements differ from the speaker-oriented choice of 来 or 去.

examples.meaning: He runs out of the school.
to go out; to come out
